exposure: Implementation of a postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) protocol that included misoprostol and the Bakri balloon
outcome: Frequency of postpartum hysterectomies due to uterine atony
cohort: 34,631 women who delivered at a Spanish hospital between January 1, 2007, and December 31, 2014
finding: Implementation of a postpartum hemorrhage protocol, including misoprostol and the Bakri balloon, was associated with decreased rates of postpartum anemia and postpartum hysterectomy due to uterine atony.
